clue.text: Hat we fetch out to keep the discussion going

indicators.note: out can mean disordered or askew, so the preceding letters are rearranged

blocks.note: the fodder, taken letter for letter

explanation.surface: Someone sends a group out for a hat as a way of prolonging a conversation.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer is CHEW THE FAT, an informal idiom.
explanation.definitionFit: To chew the fat is an informal idiom for chatting idly at length, prolonging a conversation.

clue.text: Trail round island with guide

blocks.note: to drag is to trail behind

explanation.surface: A walker follows a path around an island accompanied by a guide.
explanation.walkthrough: The Isle of Man sits in the Irish Sea; crosswords often use it for MAN.
explanation.definitionFit: A dragoman was an interpreter and escort for travellers in Arabic, Turkish or Persian-speaking lands.

clue.text: Porter or beer keeps one right

indicators.note: something that keeps another thing holds it inside itself

blocks.note: R is the abbreviation for right

explanation.surface: A choice between two drinks, porter or beer, as if one stays correct.
explanation.walkthrough: Porter looks like the dark beer in this pub scene, but it is the carrier.
explanation.definitionFit: A porter carries loads, and a bearer is likewise someone who carries things for others.

clue.text: Boss of the studio

indicators.note: of here means taken from, so the letters are a part of the next word

blocks.note: the first four letters of this word

explanation.surface: The person in charge of a film or recording studio.
explanation.walkthrough: Boss reads as the manager, but it is a raised knob or ornament.
explanation.definitionFit: A boss is a projecting knob or round ornament, and a stud is a similar small protruding fixing.

clue.text: Highly intelligent athlete put in the shade

blocks.note: a Blue is a sportsperson who has represented Oxford or Cambridge

explanation.surface: A very clever sportsman is outshone by someone else.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Put in the shade' looks like a single idiom for being outdone; only shade is the definition. A Blue is an Oxford or Cambridge university sportsperson.
explanation.definitionFit: Bright blue is a vivid colour, and a shade is one particular variety of colour.

clue.text: Pleased one is including oil extract from flowers

indicators.note: to extract something is to work it out of its original form, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A happy person makes an oil extract from flowers, like a perfumer.
explanation.walkthrough: The wordplay is loose: 'is including' just joins the parts, and extract has to signal that the three letters of oil are reordered.
explanation.definitionFit: Gladioli is the plural of gladiolus, a tall garden plant with sword-shaped leaves and spikes of blooms.

clue.text: Girl putting up drink chart

indicators.note: in a down clue, putting something up means writing it from bottom to top

explanation.surface: A girl pins up a chart of drinks, perhaps a menu.
explanation.definitionFit: Pamela is a female first name, and crosswords often define names simply as girl or boy.

clue.text: Sounds like a cat where horse should be

blocks.note: first meaning: noises a cat makes
second meaning: stabling round a yard

explanation.walkthrough: 'Sounds like' looks like a homophone signal, but it is plain: the cries a cat makes.
explanation.definitionFit: A cat mews when it cries, and mews were originally rows of stables around a yard, now often converted into houses.

clue.text: Spider that reaps?

blocks.note: first meaning: a long-legged arachnid also called a harvestman
second meaning: a person or machine gathering crops

explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the joke of a spider bringing in the crop.
explanation.definitionFit: A harvester gathers crops, and the same name covers the daddy-longlegs arachnid, called a harvestman.

clue.text: Permission to depart

explanation.walkthrough: It reads as one phrase, permission to go; the noun and the verb are separate meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: Leave is official permission for absence, and to leave is to go away from somewhere.

clue.text: Pay left-winger for bet

explanation.surface: Paying a radical left-wing politician to place a gamble.
explanation.definitionFit: To wager is to stake money on an outcome, so wagered is the past tense of placing a stake.

clue.text: A green one may be driven to drink

definitions.text: A green one may be driven to drink

blocks.clueFragment: A green one may be driven to drink
blocks.note: surface reading: someone looking queasy, pushed into drinking alcohol

blocks.clueFragment: A green one may be driven to drink
blocks.note: setter's reading: an old British army fire engine painted green, nicknamed after a deity, driven to water to pump it

explanation.walkthrough: Green Goddesses were old army fire engines brought out when Britain's firefighters went on strike; the drink is water, as in the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: The Green Goddess fire engine takes its nickname from this word, a female deity.

clue.text: Poet's pigeon

blocks.note: first meaning: the ancient Greek author of the Iliad
second meaning: a bird trained to fly back to its loft

explanation.surface: A poet owns a pet pigeon.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's reads as possessive, but it stands for is.
explanation.definitionFit: Homer is the epic poet of ancient Greece, and a homer is a homing pigeon raced back to its loft.

clue.text: A sort able to produce old instrument

indicators.note: to produce something new, the given letters are reworked into a different order

blocks.note: the fodder, taken letter for letter

explanation.surface: Someone capable of making an antique device.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sort' looks like the anagram signal, but it is part of the fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: An astrolabe is an antique astronomical device once used to measure the altitude of stars for navigation.

clue.text: Divorce results from a falsehood uttered to a large number of people

explanation.surface: A marriage breaks up after an untruth is told publicly.
explanation.definitionFit: Divorce in its wider sense is separation, and alienation is estrangement or separation from others.

clue.text: Fondness for measure to get people to enter into trade arrangement

indicators.note: an arrangement puts things in a fresh order, so the word before is rearranged
to enter into something is to go inside it

explanation.surface: A trade negotiator favours a measure to bring workers into a deal.
explanation.walkthrough: The en is a printing measure, half an em.
explanation.definitionFit: An endearment is an expression of affection, the outward sign of fondness.

clue.text: Genius at figures who's done a spell at the Treasury?

definitions.text: who's done a spell at the Treasury

blocks.note: first meaning: someone brilliant with money and numbers

blocks.clueFragment: who's done a spell at the Treasury
blocks.note: second meaning, playful: a magician who has cast a spell, or served a stint, in the finance ministry

explanation.walkthrough: Spell means a period of service, but a wizard casts spells; the Treasury is Britain's finance ministry.
explanation.definitionFit: A financial wizard is an informal phrase for a person exceptionally skilled with money and markets.

clue.text: He tells of island coming up over the hill

indicators.note: in a down clue, coming up means the word reads from bottom to top

blocks.note: a Scottish island in the Firth of Clyde
a tor is a rocky hill

explanation.surface: A storyteller describes an island rising above a hill.
explanation.walkthrough: Over places the first piece above the second in a down answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A narrator is the person who recounts a story, so he tells it.

clue.text: A boost to performance of heavenly body

explanation.surface: An athlete's drug gives a performance by a celebrity a lift.
explanation.definitionFit: An asteroid is a small rocky object orbiting the sun, a celestial body.

clue.text: Disposition to put up with minor degree of variation

blocks.note: first meaning: willingness to endure others
second meaning: permitted deviation in engineering measurements

explanation.definitionFit: Tolerance is patience with what one dislikes, and in engineering it is the allowed margin of error in a dimension.

clue.text: The character of a landlord?

blocks.note: first meaning: a symbol of the alphabet
second meaning, playful: one who lets property

explanation.walkthrough: Character reads as personality, but it is a written symbol; the question mark flags the invented sense of one who lets.
explanation.definitionFit: A letter is an alphabetic symbol, and whimsically a landlord who lets out rooms is a letter too.

clue.text: Favourite artist from old city

blocks.note: a teacher's pet is a favourite

explanation.surface: A beloved painter comes from an ancient town.
explanation.walkthrough: RA, Royal Academician, is the standard crossword artist.
explanation.definitionFit: Petra is the ruined ancient rock-cut capital of the Nabataeans in present-day Jordan.

clue.text: Paper ordered - you first send the money in advance

indicators.note: ordered means arranged anew, so the word before is rearranged
first asks for the opening letter of the word before it

explanation.surface: A newspaper subscription: you must pay up front.
explanation.walkthrough: The dash makes it look like an instruction to a reader; first only takes the opening letter of you.
explanation.definitionFit: To prepay is to pay a bill before the goods or service is delivered.

clue.text: To a soldier extent of space proves drawback

definitions.note: read as the verb draw back

blocks.note: a tract is an area of land

explanation.surface: For a soldier, a stretch of ground to cross is a disadvantage.
explanation.walkthrough: Drawback reads as a disadvantage, but it must be split into draw back to match the verb. RE is the Royal Engineers.
explanation.definitionFit: To retract is to pull or draw something back in, as a cat does with claws.

clue.text: Sway to the music

blocks.note: first meaning: move gently to and fro
second meaning: a popular musical genre

explanation.surface: Someone moves in time with a song.
explanation.definitionFit: To rock is to move back and forth, and rock is the guitar-driven genre of popular song.

clue.text: The more unusual form of demonstrable principle

indicators.note: an unusual form of something has its parts set out differently

blocks.note: the fodder, taken letter for letter

explanation.surface: A rarer version of a proven rule, as in a maths textbook.
explanation.definitionFit: A theorem is a mathematical statement that can be proved from axioms.

clue.text: Sound of grief caused by row

indicators.note: sound of means the answer is heard as another word

blocks.note: a tear is a drop shed in grief

explanation.surface: Sobbing brought on by a quarrel.
explanation.walkthrough: Row looks like a quarrel, but it is a line or level; tear here rhymes with fear.
explanation.definitionFit: A tier is one of a series of rows or levels placed one above another, as in seating.

clue.text: Company in red, I believe

indicators.note: a company in a colour is dressed in it, so one word wraps around the other

explanation.surface: A political allegiance: you think the firm is red.
explanation.walkthrough: In usually puts the first word inside, but here the company wears red, so the colour sits inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Credo is Latin for I believe, and opens the Creed; it now means any set of beliefs.

clue.text: Action on speech about exercise

indicators.note: about means placed around something else

explanation.surface: A talk that promotes physical activity.
explanation.walkthrough: PE is physical education, the school exercise lesson.
explanation.definitionFit: An operation is an act or process of functioning, especially a military or business action.
